solutions.title: Extra buffer for non-zero values
solutions.strategy: Collect non-zero values, write them back first, then fill the remaining positions with zeroes.

timeComplexity.explanation: The input is scanned once and the output positions are written once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The temporary list can store every value if the array has no zeroes.

solutions.title: In-place non-zero write pointer
solutions.strategy: Move non-zero values forward with a write pointer, then overwrite the rest with zeroes.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value is read once and each array slot is written at most once after compaction.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the write index is needed beyond the input array.
